```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "85%")

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(gtsummary)

tables_dir  <- here("outputs", "tables")
figures_dir <- here("outputs", "figures")
models_dir  <- here("outputs", "models")

# This report assembles pre-produced outputs; it does NOT re-fit any model.

# --- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  out <- ifelse(is.na(p), "—",
           ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  ifelse(!is.na(p) & p < 0.05, paste0("<strong>", out, "</strong>"), out)
}

styled <- function(tbl, caption) {
  kbl(tbl, caption = caption, escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", ncol(tbl) - 1))) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
}

# Marginal means at all timepoints. Baseline (T1) is the model intercept and
# is identical in both groups by construction.
show_means <- function(file, caption, baseline_note = TRUE) {
  read_csv(file.path(tables_dir, file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      Group     = group_f,
      Timepoint = time_f,
      Mean      = round(emmean, 2),
      SE        = round(SE, 2),
      `95% CI`  = sprintf("%.2f, %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL)
    ) %>%
    styled(if (baseline_note) paste(caption, "Baseline (T1) is the same in both groups by model construction.") else caption)
}

show_contrasts <- function(file, caption) {
  read_csv(file.path(tables_dir, file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      Contrast   = contrast,
      Timepoint  = time_f,
      Estimate   = round(estimate, 2),
      SE         = round(SE, 2),
      `95% CI`   = sprintf("%.2f, %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL),
      `Cohen's d (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cohen_d, d_lower, d_upper),
      p          = fmt_p(p.value)
    ) %>%
    styled(caption)
}

show_figure <- function(file) {
  knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figures_dir, file))
}

# Make GEE term names human-readable
relabel_terms <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\(Intercept\\)", "Intercept (baseline, both groups)", x)
  x <- sub("^t([34]):int$", "Group \u00d7 Time T\\1 (Intervention vs. Waitlist)", x)
  x <- sub("^t([34])$", "Time T\\1 (change from T1, Waitlist)", x)
  x
}

# Pooled GEE model coefficients
show_model <- function(file, caption) {
  read_csv(file.path(tables_dir, file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      Term       = relabel_terms(term),
      Estimate   = round(estimate, 3),
      SE         = round(std.error, 3),
      `95% CI`   = sprintf("%.3f, %.3f", conf.low, conf.high),
      p          = fmt_p(p.value),
      FMI        = round(fmi, 2)
    ) %>%
    styled(caption)
}

# Tables (a, b, c) and figure for one continuous outcome
outcome_section <- function(prefix, heading, short, table_no, figure_no) {
  cat("\n\n---\n\n## ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(as.character(show_model(paste0(prefix, "_model_summary.csv"),
        sprintf("Table %sa. %s GEE model coefficients (pooled).", table_no, short))), "\n\n")
  cat(as.character(show_means(paste0(prefix, "_marginal_means.csv"),
        sprintf("Table %sb. %s estimated marginal means.", table_no, short))), "\n\n")
  cat(as.character(show_contrasts(paste0(prefix, "_contrasts.csv"),
        sprintf("Table %sc. %s group contrasts by timepoint.", table_no, short))), "\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("![Figure %s. %s estimated marginal means over time, by group.](%s){width=85%%}\n\n",
              figure_no, short, file.path(figures_dir, paste0(prefix, "_marginal_means.png"))))
}
```

---

# Overview of analysis plan

- **Groups:** Waitlist (Control) vs. Intervention (Motherly Plus).
- **Timepoints:** T1 (baseline), T2 (week 2), T3 (week 4, post-treatment), T4 (week 8, follow-up).
- **Primary outcome:**
    - Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology, Clinician-Rated (QIDS-C16) total score at T3
- **Secondary outcomes (T3 and T4, unless noted):**
    - Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology, Self-Report (QIDS-SR16)
    - Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7)
    - Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI)
    - Parenting Stress Index – Short Form (PSI-SF): parental distress, parent-child dysfunctional interaction and total stress
    - Sheehan Disability Scale (SDS)
    - Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS)
    - Clinical Global Impression – Improvement (CGI-I), T3 only
- **Analysis:**
    - Intention-to-treat: all randomized participants.
    - Missing data: described before the analyses (availability of each outcome by group). Missing values were then handled by multiple imputation by chained equations (MICE, 100 imputations), with results pooled by Rubin's rules.
    - Model: generalized estimating equations (GEE) with AR1 working correlation and robust standard errors, fitted as
      `outcome ~ time + time × group` (no group main effect; Twisk et al., 2018, equation 2d).
      Baseline (T1) is the intercept and is assumed equal in both groups by randomization, so the effect of the intervention at each follow-up is the `Group × Time` coefficient.
    - CGI-I (T3 only, no baseline) was analyzed as a continuous score (1–7) with a linear regression on group.
    - Two-sided α = 0.05; 95% confidence intervals; Cohen's d = group contrast divided by the pooled within-group standard deviation at that timepoint.
    - A complete-case analysis (no imputation) of every outcome is reported separately.

In all contrasts the comparison is **Waitlist − Intervention**, so a
**positive estimate (and positive d) favors the intervention** (higher symptom
score in the waitlist group). The `Group × Time` coefficients in the model
tables have the opposite sign (Intervention − Waitlist), so a negative
coefficient also favors the intervention. FMI is the fraction of missing
information of each pooled parameter.

# Primary outcome: Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology, Clinician-Rated (QIDS-C16), at T3

GEE model coefficients (pooled over the imputed datasets). The
`Group × Time` term is the effect of the intervention at that timepoint
(Intervention − Waitlist): a negative coefficient indicates greater symptom
reduction in the intervention group. Significant *p*-values (< 0.05) are shown
in **bold**.

```{r primary-model}
show_model("07_qids_model_summary.csv", "Table 3a. QIDS-C16 GEE model coefficients (pooled).")
```

```{r primary-means}
show_means("07_qids_marginal_means.csv", "Table 3b. QIDS-C16 estimated marginal means.")
```

```{r primary-contrasts}
show_contrasts("07_qids_contrasts.csv", "Table 3c. QIDS-C16 group contrast at T3.")
```

```{r fig-primary, fig.cap="Figure 1. QIDS-C16 estimated marginal means at baseline (T1) and post-treatment (T3), by group."}
show_figure("07_qids_marginal_means.png")
```

## Clinical Global Impression – Improvement (CGI-I) at T3

Clinical Global Impression – Improvement is measured at T3 and has no baseline value. It is scored from 1 (very much improved) to 7 (very much worse) and analyzed as a continuous outcome, with a linear regression on group in each imputed dataset (pooled). The contrast is Waitlist − Intervention, so a positive estimate favors the intervention (lower score = more improvement).

```{r cgi-means}
show_means("08_cgi_marginal_means.csv", "Table 12a. CGI-I estimated marginal means at T3.", baseline_note = FALSE)
```

```{r cgi-contrasts}
show_contrasts("08_cgi_contrasts.csv", "Table 12b. CGI-I group contrast at T3.")
```

```{r fig-cgi, fig.cap="Figure 10. CGI-I estimated marginal means at post-treatment (T3), by group. Scores range from 1 (very much improved) to 7 (very much worse)."}
show_figure("08_cgi_marginal_means.png")
```

# Complete-case analysis

Analysis without imputation. For each outcome, only participants observed at
**every** timepoint of that outcome are included (participants with any missing
value are excluded before fitting, so they do not contribute even their
baseline). The models are the same as in the intention-to-treat analyses and
are fitted once on the observed data (CGI-I: linear regression on group). *n* is the number analyzed in the
Waitlist (W) and Intervention (I) groups, and *Excluded* is the
number of randomized participants left out.

```{r cc-contrasts}
read_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "09_cc_contrasts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    Outcome    = outcome,
    Timepoint  = time_f,
    `n (W / I)` = sprintf("%d / %d", n_waitlist, n_intervention),
    Excluded   = n_excluded,
    Estimate   = round(estimate, 2),
    SE         = round(SE, 2),
    `95% CI`   = sprintf("%.2f, %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL),
    `Cohen's d (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cohen_d, d_lower, d_upper),
    p          = fmt_p(p.value)
  ) %>%
  styled("Table 13. Complete-case group contrasts (Waitlist − Intervention) by timepoint.")
```
